question: How much position-level and boundary error remains in the frozen M28C B0 on the protected chr22 validation seed, without using that seed for inference or deciding whether BR/BS should run?

amendment_history.reason: The initial draft bound seed 20260817 truth to B0 predictions generated from seed 20260818. The second pre-scoring audit detected the mismatch before the real truth was parsed or scored.

Bind seed 20260818 truth, simulation outputs, materialized target, ingest and both predictions through authenticated manifests; authenticate both replicas before either score; add implementation hashes, coordinate-source checks and explicit undefined-metric handling.

fixed_domain.coordinate_convention: inclusive integer bp domain [first_b0_marker,last_b0_marker] represented internally as half-open overlaps
fixed_domain.interpretation: ASIA is the generic source in AmericanAdmixture_4B18 and must not be relabelled as NAM.

prediction_partition.policy: Assign each B0 marker the FB probabilities and MSP hard labels of its internal Gnomix window, using MSP n_snps in order; include the terminal 241-marker window.
prediction_partition.voronoi_policy: For consecutive marker positions x_i and x_i+1, the left marker ends at floor((x_i+x_i+1)/2) and the right marker starts one bp later. Ties go to the left marker.
prediction_partition.integration_policy: Split prediction cells at every truth-segment boundary and integrate exact half-open overlaps; never assign truth from only a marker or window centre.

genetic_coordinate_validation.fb_policy: FB genetic_position is a finite monotone representative that must lie inside its MSP interval; it is not used as a cM coordinate for scoring.
genetic_coordinate_validation.rationale: B0 cM is stored at higher precision. Gnomix MSP endpoints are rounded to five decimal places, so 1e-5 cM is a format-derived tolerance rather than a result-selected threshold.

primary_estimand.name: bp_weighted_macro_normalized_ancestry_dosage_mae
primary_estimand.predicted_dosage: For sample i and ancestry a, d_hat_ia=P(h0=a)+P(h1=a).
primary_estimand.aggregation_order: Integrate by bp within sample and ancestry; divide by the exact domain length; average samples within ancestry; then give AFR, EUR and ASIA equal weight.
primary_estimand.conditional_diagnostic: Also report error conditional on truth dosage >0 for each ancestry, with its own bp denominator.

secondary_estimands.cm_weighted_dosage_mae: Sensitivity using the same exact overlaps and non-negative interpolated cM weights; never the primary endpoint.
secondary_estimands.normalized_dosage_mse: Squared error of d_hat/2 against d/2, named explicitly and not presented as a calibration guarantee.
secondary_estimands.haplotype_brier: For each haplotype, sum the three squared probability errors and divide by 2; average the two haplotypes, weight by bp and minimize only over the two global haplotype permutations per sample. Range [0,1]; local window-wise swaps are forbidden.
secondary_estimands.hard_diploid_state: Accuracy and fixed-six-class macro-F1 over unordered AA, EE, SS, AE, AS and ES states; probability ties resolve AFR before EUR before ASIA and unsupported classes have F1 zero.
secondary_estimands.boundary_error: Ancestry-label transitions only, excluding silent donor changes. Match the same ordered transition one-to-one, maximize match count then minimize total cM distance, and choose between only the two global haplotype permutations per sample.

boundary_tolerances_cm.rationale: 0.2 cM is the frozen Gnomix window-size anchor; 0.1 and 0.5 cM are fixed resolution sensitivities and will not be selected by their result.

secondary_estimands.boundary_reporting: For every tolerance and each of the six directed ancestry transitions report truth, predicted, matched, missed and extra boundaries, precision, recall, F1, and median/p95 distance among matched boundaries. A metric is null only when its denominator is absent; when truth and prediction denominators exist but matches are zero, precision, recall and F1 are 0.

truth_informed_diagnostic.name: truth_informed_global_composition_diagnostic
truth_informed_diagnostic.definition: For each sample and ancestry, use constant normalized dosage equal to its true bp-weighted global ancestry proportion inside the fixed B0 domain.
truth_informed_diagnostic.role: Descriptive truth-informed global-composition diagnostic only; it is circular, is not an MAE lower bound, and must never enter a gate, select parameters or be described as a deployable baseline.

unresolved_before_inference.SESOI: No defensible project value is frozen. The prior 0.005 suggestion remains a hypothesis, not a decision.
unresolved_before_inference.independent_seeds: No exact number is justified. Technical A/B replicates and mosaics from one simulation seed are not independent scientific replicates.
unresolved_before_inference.policy: M28D may end only as B0_DESCRIBED. A separate PRE based on a prospective power/precision design is required before any ceiling decision or BR/BS run.

post_access_seed_policy: After successful scoring, seed 20260818 is consumed for descriptive inspection and cannot be reused as independent validation or to select SESOI, seed count, metrics, parameters or BR/BS execution.

gates.D0_AUTH: Before either score parses truth, a pair-level receipt must authenticate contract, truth hash, B0, map, both FB/MSP pairs, M28C comparison, simulation outputs, B0 materialization, ingest and both inference manifests. Root seed, tree sequence/mosaic/pool outputs, target VCF and predictions must form one lineage.
gates.D1_ALIGNMENT: Exactly 30 target samples, two haplotypes, three frozen ancestry labels, 371 paired FB/MSP windows and 79791 ordered B0 markers align; MSP n_snps sums exactly to 79791.
gates.D2_DOMAIN: Truth and authenticated map cover the complete fixed B0 domain; B0 cM matches the map within 1e-8, rounded MSP endpoints within 1e-5, FB representatives lie inside MSP intervals, Voronoi cells and exact overlaps have no gaps or overlaps, bp weights sum to 34398091 and genetic span is positive.
gates.D3_PROBABILITY: Every FB value is finite in [0,1], each haplotype ancestry vector sums to one within 1e-6, each predicted dosage is in [0,2] and ancestry dosages sum to two within 2e-6.
gates.D4_KNOWN_ANSWER: Every named synthetic known-answer check, including finite non-normalized probabilities, truth clipping, malformed haplotypes, command-level A/B scoring and invalid-scope comparison, passes before real truth is parsed.
gates.D5_PHASE: Primary, unordered hard-state and globally aligned secondary metrics are invariant to a global haplotype swap.
gates.D6_BOUNDARY: Matching is ordered one-to-one, label-aware and reports missed/extra transitions at all frozen tolerances.
gates.D7_REPRODUCIBILITY: A and B documents first pass frozen stage, decision, scope, seed and authorization guards; their aggregate scientific payloads are then identical after removing only replicate/provenance identifiers.
gates.D8_SCOPE: No SESOI, interval, p-value, ceiling decision, BR/BS authorization, NAM label or real-data claim is produced.

stop_rule: Stop before scientific scoring on any hash, schema, coordinate, sample, haplotype, ancestry, window, marker, domain, truth-coverage, map, probability, dosage, weight, phase-invariance or known-answer failure. After scoring, do not interpret positive probabilistic error alone as correctable LAI error, do not use the truth-informed global-composition diagnostic as a gate, do not estimate a SESOI or independent-seed count from this seed, and do not open BR/BS.
